record.title: Preserve two finalized raw backings through verified lossless archives
record.intent: Recover bounded guest headroom while retaining exact evidence and overlay restoration paths.
requirements: Restrict replacement to the two raw userdata backings pinned in experiments/adc-input-capture/capacity-review.toml. Preserve dependent overlays, every indexed artifact and reference inputs unchanged. Reject changed candidates or active image users.

Implement a bounded lossless archival tool with a project-relative restoration manifest, original mode size and SHA-256, archive SHA-256, dependent overlay SHA-256 and original restoration location. Test exact restoration into fresh independent regular files before any source replacement or removal.

Validate archive creation and restored byte identity, close the restoration stream and retain a complete recoverable archive before removing a redundant raw backing. Recheck source and overlay hashes and open users immediately before removal. Do not use hardlinks or alter original indexes.

Exercise positive restoration and negative changed-source, corrupt-archive and active-user controls on independent small fixtures. Record actual free-space changes and any COW limitation. Stop on mismatch or failure; preserve transaction state for recovery.

Keep the 2097152KiB preboot gate unchanged; no guest launch or host policy change. Commit and push the archival conclusion before any guest run. Restore the exact raw to its original location before dependent overlay reuse.
acceptance: Exact restoration is demonstrated and capacity is recorded
or a precise preservation or capacity blocker is committed and pushed.
